verdict.rationale: The pricing page lists "AI Automatically Syncs Emails, Events, and Contacts," which supports calendar/event sync into Sales Cloud. Contact and opportunity records are also documented. However, nothing shows that synced meetings appear on contact or deal timelines, and the evidence is a single feature-list line. Missing for 10: confirmation that synced meetings appear on contact and opportunity activity timelines, details on which calendar providers are supported and how setup works, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
